ios.desc:
Vehicle Maintenance Log turns any mechanic invoice into a permanent, searchable record in less than 20 seconds; just snap a photo and the app does the rest.

Point your camera at any invoice; paper, screenshot, or printed email. The app reads the service type, date, mileage, and cost automatically. Zero typing. Zero spreadsheets. Your complete service history, always in your pocket.

Core Features:

- Build a complete, permanent service history for your vehicle
- Log any invoice in 20 seconds. Photo, screenshot, or manual entry
- Search, review, and access every record instantly from your phone

Upgrade to Basic — $12.99/year (auto-renewing)

For $1.08 a month, protect thousands in resale value and stop paying for services you already had done. Here is what you unlock:

- Track up to 2 vehicles with unlimited invoices. No caps, ever
- Export your full service history to CSV and send it to any email in one tap
- Search and filter by service type or year. Find any record in seconds
- Show buyers documented proof of every service at resale time

Support & Feedback

We read every message and respond quickly. Feature requests are welcome! What gets built next comes directly from what YOU ask for.
https://VehicleMaintenanceLogApp.com/contact

Your Car's History Is Worth Money. Start Building It Today.

Documented service records add $1,000 to $2,000 to your resale value. At $12.99 a year, Vehicle Maintenance Log is the simplest investment you will ever make in a vehicle you plan to sell.

quotes.text:
Ive built a simple iOS app that allows users to take a picture or screenshot of their mechanic invoice and within seconds it automatically processes and chronologically orders the logs. You can also export all of this information to an email.

I think this would be useful for a person selling a car to prove all of the work done to the vehicle over the years along with the actual image of the invoice exportable as well.

The app is called Vehicle Maintenance Log and you can check out the landing page, https://vehiclemaintenancelogapp.com for more info if this interests you. Its also currently in the iOS App Store ...curious if you would use this to prove all maintenance with screenshots of the invoices to back it up?! Let me know your thoughts on the app!
